_doc: Single-pod calibration (AGENTS.md §7 step 1): ONE fleet pod against an over-provisioned 32-core server, sweeping --connections (via CONNS_PER_POD) to find the single-pod max at fleet_cpu=2 / payload 256. 50k streams keeps perpod >= connections. The orchestrator runs this once per connection level and reads the p1 cell throughput.
